controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color of a blackbody at the star's temperature. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. No limb darkening is drawn: at 7,740 K and log g 8.03 no model grid used here reaches it (Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 (ATLAS): The limb-darkening grid is empty.; Reeve & Howarth (2016), MNRAS 456, 1294 (non-LTE TLUSTY): 7740 is outside the grid 27500, 30000, 32500, 35000, 37500, 40000, 42500, 45000, 47500, 50000, 52500, 55000.; Neilson & Lester (2013), A&A 554, A98 (spherical ATLAS (SATLAS)): the grid is of spherical models, read by mass, and the star has no measured mass; Howarth (2011), MNRAS 413, 1515: 7740 is outside the grid .; Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 (PHOENIX): The limb-darkening grid is empty.; PICASO 4.1 (Batalha et al. 2019, ApJ 878, 70) (Sonora Bobcat cloud-free (Marley et al. 2021, ApJ 920, 85)): the PICASO toolchain holds no Bobcat profiles: node packages/telescope-cli/src/toolchains/astronomy-toolchains.mts picaso install). The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.
